identity.title: Add projection and signal storage tables

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Add two small read-side persistence structures only: one execution projection record per run and zero-to-many governance signal records per run. Use a late-numbered SQLite migration to avoid collision with existing migrations; keep raw events authoritative. Dependency: 8008.add-evidence-import-cli.
human_pressure.why_now: Run reports and fleet aggregation need queryable derived state without scanning and reinterpreting raw events in every HTTP request.
do_not_misread: This pack is intentionally narrow; do not absorb later packs into it.
Evidence is authoritative; derived state must remain reconstructable from evidence.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.

machine_core.goal: Add minimal SQLite storage for disposable execution projections and evidence-linked governance signals.
red_lines: Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
invariants: Depends on: 8008.add-evidence-import-cli. Do not implement this pack against an incompatible predecessor state.
failure_semantics: Projection persistence failure leaves raw evidence intact and reportable as projection unavailable.

steps.title: Create projection table
details: run_id primary key, projection schema/version, source, lifecycle/outcome/validation summary columns, projection_json, updated_at.
Keep flexible details in JSON rather than premature normalized tables.

steps.title: Create signal table
details: signal_id primary key, run_id, type, severity, subject, evidence_refs_json, details_json, created_at.

steps.title: Add storage CRUD
details: Replace/delete signals for a run transactionally when rebuilding.

steps.title: Test migration/idempotency
details: Projection rebuild replaces derived rows without touching events.

acceptance: Existing database migration path remains valid.
Projection can be upserted/replaced independently of raw events.
Signals can be replaced for one run without changing source evidence.

must_check: Raw events remain source of truth.
Migration is idempotent under existing init flow.
reject_if: Migration assumes an unavailable external service.
Unknown or missing evidence is treated as passed.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path for non-capability reasons.
